debug.heading: Debug
debug.hint: Left-drag selects. Right-click moves, herds, fells a tree, or sends people to build a site; shift queues. More people on a site build it faster. P patrols. Fields lose condition unless someone stands on them — G rests the one under the cursor, which repairs it but harvests nothing. Ctrl+4-9 groups, 4-9 recalls. 1-3 build, F plants a field, T trains, R researches. ` pauses, +/- speed.
debug.controlsHeading: Controls — H to fold, F1 for stats

panel.allyHint: A tie costs cattle every season and sends grain to whichever of you goes hungry
panel.breakHint: They will remember it, and so will everyone else. Your trade rates suffer for a long time
panel.cullHint: Meat now, and fewer mouths to feed every season after. The herd is also your wealth
panel.rationShortHint: The village eats less and works slower. Grain lasts, building does not.
panel.rationFullHint: Back to full commons: the village eats its fill and works at full speed.
